tasks.title: Commission Claude Code and Codex external packages
tasks.goal: Prove both mandatory client contracts through external package data and isolated runtime verification.
steps: Create captured fixture packages for Claude Code and Codex using the accepted open descriptor schema; record exact client versions.
Run install/update/verify/recover/remove for each required scope/shape in isolated homes, inspecting real client state where available.
Compare core executable identity before/after introducing the descriptor; retain exact settings/resources and foreign-neighbor snapshots.
positive_cases: Both clients load expected projected resources and execute the supported local launch contract.
Update and remove affect only the receipt-owned set.
negative_cases: Wrong client version, truncated client output and foreign occupancy refuse.
Fixture-runner-only success cannot substitute for required actual client commissioning.
acceptance: Each required matrix row has exact client/core/capture/effect evidence.
Real user homes, secrets and installed client configuration remain untouched.
tasks.safe_stop: Available isolated client evidence is complete; missing mandatory runtime remains pending.
tasks.commit_subject: test(adapters): commission external Claude and Codex lifecycles
notes: Do not download/install clients implicitly. Root binds exact prepared client runtimes and any explicit preparation authority.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Commission OpenCode and Qwen without core changes
tasks.goal: Close remaining mandatory clients and the no-core-release extensibility proof.
steps: Create OpenCode and Qwen fixture descriptors with complete declared resource closure; use current exact documented client versions.
Execute full required lifecycle in isolated roots, including nested skill resources/config members and unsupported-operation refusal.
Add a further synthetic new-client descriptor using the same operations and prove it is accepted by the unchanged core binary; gather four-client coverage together.
positive_cases: OpenCode and Qwen resources/settings survive full install/update/remove with foreign state preserved.
The unchanged binary recognizes an added package-defined client.
negative_cases: Qwen documentation, detection or a fourth enum variant is not runtime proof.
Missing nested resource, unsupported mandatory row or lost foreign key prevents milestone acceptance.
acceptance: All four mandatory matrices have independent observed-state evidence.
No required client row closes on an unsupported placeholder.
tasks.safe_stop: Four-client/external extensibility evidence is ready for parent review.
